title: Surreal Gothic Flower Scene
description: A surreal scene set on a stone courtyard features an enormous purple flower with a woman in a dark dress kneeling beside it and another woman emerging from its center. In the background stands a towering purple Gothic cathedral with a rose window, while to the right a couple in formal attire toasts with martini glasses inside a large transparent bubble surrounded by smaller bubbles.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene on a stone courtyard with a massive vibrant purple flower in the foreground. A woman in a dark patterned dress kneels beside it while another woman rises from the flower's green center. In the background a tall purple Gothic cathedral with rose window stands under a yellow and purple sky. To the right a man in a white suit and a woman in a magenta dress sit inside a large transparent bubble, toasting with martini glasses, surrounded by floating bubbles.
